data.one_liner: Detect CI environments and inspect CI vendor details in Dart scripts.
data.what_it_does: Inspects environment variables to determine whether code is executing within a continuous integration (CI) service. It provides vendor detection (e.g., GitHub Actions) and identifies whether the current run was triggered by a pull request. The package requires zero runtime dependencies and is designed for CLI tools and scripts.
use_when: You are building CLI tools or build scripts that need different behavior when executed locally versus in CI.
You need to detect whether a CI build is running for a pull request.
You want to identify the specific CI vendor hosting your execution environment.
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application where CI detection is irrelevant.
You only need basic platform environment variable lookups without vendor-specific metadata.
strengths: Supports vendor detection sourced from the widely used watson/ci-info database.
Simple top-level API with boolean flags and vendor properties.
weaknesses: Very early release version (0.1.0) with minimal documentation.
Does not support the web platform.
